metadata.title: Federal Act on Medicinal Products and Medical Devices (Therapeutic Products Act, TPA / Heilmittelgesetz, HMG), SR 812.21
metadata.edition: SR 812.21 · Art. 59 (mandatory notification); Arts. 62 and 64 (data confidentiality, disclosure abroad) · Art. 59 paras. 3, 3bis, 5–7 as amended by the Federal Act of 18 March 2016 (in force 1 January 2019); read on the droit-bilingue.ch bilingual mirror
